summary: Verified removal of 'Hubungkan Drive' (open-external-button) and 'File' (open-files-button) from the putusan detail topbar. All remaining topbar actions present and functional. No console errors; Tax Knowledge and Tax Database views load normally.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js header on line 536 is a massive single-line JSX string — hard to read/maintain. Consider formatting multi-line and extracting the Topbar into its own component.
App.js overall size is very large; splitting into feature components (Topbar, DatabaseView, PutusanView, ChatPanel) would improve maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Topbar on putusan detail now has exactly 5 actions: open-branding-button, open-peraturan-button, url-import-toggle, document-upload-label, try-assistant-button. 'open-external-button' and 'open-files-button' and Cloud icon import have been fully removed. Note: selector `[data-testid^='database-putusan-']` also matches `database-putusan-filters` (the filter row div) — use `button[data-testid^='database-putusan-']` to target items only.
